role: Every agent message from every committed walk of this task, and what the grader makes of it as post-probe text. A case is bound to the message's sha256, so it cannot drift onto a paraphrase.
not_a_claim: A case is NOT a claim that the message should carry that label. Most are pre-probe templates and narration no take would hand a grader. Their value is that a grader returning `correct` for a message which answers nothing would award a pass to noise.

hand_labelling_rule: Each case was read with its label and assigned a verdict by the class of message it is. The classes and their reasoning are recorded per case rather than as a blanket judgment, so a reader can disagree with one without discarding the suite. A case is `sound` when the label is right for that message; `noise-correct` when a message that answers nothing receives a CORRECT label, which is a defect; `review` when a human looked and was unsure.
